title: The 50-30-20 Rule Visual Guide
summary: Visual diagram demonstrating how to divide any monthly allowance into 50% Needs, 30% Wants, and 20% Savings.
bulletPoints: 50% Needs: Housing, groceries, commute, utilities, medical
30% Wants: Hobbies, eating out, entertainment, shopping
20% Savings: Emergency fund, investments, long-term goals

title: Needs vs Wants Decision Matrix
summary: A 3-step decision flow diagram that guides students through impulse evaluation before making any purchase.
bulletPoints: Step 1: Does not buying this prevent safety, health, or education?
Step 2: Can I comfortably afford it without borrowing?
Step 3: Wait 24 hours to test emotional vs real demand.

title: The Student Monthly Budget Cycle
summary: A 4-stage cyclical roadmap: Plan Income -> Track Daily Outflows -> Review Variance -> Adjust Next Month.
bulletPoints: Week 1: Allocate funds immediately upon receiving allowance
Week 2 & 3: Log transactions in the Expense Tracker
Week 4: Review remaining balances and transfer surplus to Savings

title: 30-Day Student Savings Challenge
summary: An engaging progressive savings challenge table designed to save PKR 10,000+ in 30 small daily steps.
bulletPoints: Day 1-10: Save PKR 100/day by cutting discretionary snacks
Day 11-20: Save PKR 250/day with home-cooked meal prep
Day 21-30: Save PKR 400/day through subscription audit & discounts

title: Student Smart Grocery & Dining Guide
summary: Tactical infographics on bulk purchasing, generic brands, student meal prep, and avoiding supermarket traps.
bulletPoints: Never shop on an empty stomach (reduces junk purchases by 40%)
Buy store-brand staple grains and pulses instead of imported brands
Cook batch meals on Sundays to avoid expensive weekday deliveries
